items.q: What kind of projects do you take?
items.a: Freelance projects and technical collaborations in backend (Java with Spring Boot, Python with FastAPI), web applications (Angular, React), Windows utilities (C++, C#) and AI automation.
Write to me through the form, by email or on Telegram with a short description of what you need. We talk about the scope and, if it fits, I send you a proposal with phases and deliverables.

items.q: How much does a project cost?
items.a: It depends on the scope. After the first conversation I prepare a proposal with the work breakdown and the budget.

items.q: Which languages can I write in?
Can I see the code of your private projects?
items.a: Some projects contain proprietary code or client integrations, so I publish case studies instead. I can explain their architecture, my role and the technical decisions without showing the code.

items.q: Do you use AI in your work?
items.a: Yes, as a development tool: to explore code, implement, test and review. I make the calls on architecture, business rules, security and final verification.

items.q: What do you do with my data if I write to you?
items.a: I only use it to reply.
